## Current-head hosted evidence
At PR #46 head `5a853daa462d1766061edc26789c30f0fdeec46f`, the full [Node 22 job](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/40583097964/job/122467426453) reports 722 tests, 714 passing and eight failing. [Node 26](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/actions/runs/40583097964/job/122467426662) independently reports the same terminal-import and seeded assignee-preservation assertion classes. The npm and Bun release jobs are also failed. These are hosted synthetic test results, not a live Azure incident or a local crash reproduction.

Several existing terminal-import/close recovery tests now return `ADO_CONFLICT` with “Native item history advanced; re-read both trackers and retry” where successful terminal reconciliation is expected:
- terminal states import (test/sync.test.ts:686);
- import-close boundary matrix (:1477);
- native close assignment recovery (:2596);
- unassigned terminal close recovery (:2699);
- canonical status aliases after close interruption (:3004).

The unchanged 512-sequence model also fails at seed `3404983668`, sequence `326`: “lost assignee edit”. The retained diagnostic shows an empty remote-assignee edit pending, a failed `ADO_REMOTE` attempt, then a resumed success exporting assignee and iteration-path. This establishes a failed preservation oracle, not yet its root cause or evidence of customer data loss. Coverage failures remain additional gate failures, not the explanation for these eight functional failures.

## Source goal and scope
The [canonical SDK adoption item](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/5a853daa462d1766061edc26789c30f0fdeec46f/.agents/pm/chores/pm-ado-sdk-adoption.toon) requires native lifecycle preservation, preserved concurrent edits and unchanged full acceptance gates. The [accepted R8 fallback](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/5a853daa462d1766061edc26789c30f0fdeec46f/.agents/pm/issues/pm-ado-sdk-history-fence.toon) explicitly permits post-write verification/append-only compensation pending upstream pm-cli#1576. This report does not reject that accepted design or label compensation equivalent to pre-write CAS.

The changed [history-fence.ts](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/5a853daa462d1766061edc26789c30f0fdeec46f/history-fence.ts) verifies an exact native head and propagates `NativeHistoryConflict`; [sync.ts](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/5a853daa462d1766061edc26789c30f0fdeec46f/sync.ts#L433-L446) routes scalar, prepared close, terminal transition and assignment through the fenced writer. These are investigation locations, not a proven causal diagnosis.

## Expected / impact
Supported terminal reconciliation should preserve native close semantics and mapped assignment/recovery without refusing its own legitimate native history. The seeded two-sided model must preserve every pending user edit through failure and resume. Current full gates fail these assertions despite focused history-fence checks passing, so PR #46 is not release-certified.

## Acceptance / regression
- Minimize the terminal-conflict cases and seed 3404983668 / sequence 326 using the existing synthetic fixtures; identify whether implementation or an evidenced invalid oracle is responsible.
- Keep the monotonic native-history fence, fail-closed stale/ABA refusal, complete native lifecycle effects and append-only audit history. Do not weaken the guard merely to make these tests pass.
- Preserve an empty assignee edit as a real edit through failure/retry; retain terminal native assignment clearing and mapped recovery distinctions.
- Rerun the existing failing tests, the complete model, native-precondition/verification checks and full Node 22/26 npm/Bun gates on one immutable head, retaining coverage thresholds.
- Report provider, crash and artifact verification separately. No live Azure writes were performed for this review.

Deduplication: all 59 all-status GitHub issue/PR records, PR conversation/inline/review records and the current SDK adoption/history-fence/terminal-match PM items were checked. #59 is the prior coverage-only failure on an older revision; pm-cli#1576 is the missing upstream pre-write API. Neither is this current full-suite functional failure outcome. PR #46 and pm-ado-sdk-adoption remain the implementation owners.
